name: Stellenbosch

climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

soil.rock: Sandstone is sand bound into rock. It weathers to light, sandy soil that drains freely. Granite weathers to coarse, acid, free-draining soil that warms quickly and holds heat. Its acidity tends to lower the grapes' acidity, which suits Gamay.

land: The high ground runs about 11°F cooler than the low ground. Higher vineyards ripen later and keep more acidity, so one grape can make lighter or richer wine here depending on height.

winkler: Good for generous crops of standard to good wine.
